announcements.headline: Full Launch of Virtual Card Capability
announcements.insight: RC365 Holding follows its October soft launch by fully launching virtual card capability. This progression suggests operational advancement in its wealth management system offerings.

announcements.headline: RC AI Brain Product Update
announcements.insight: RCGH updates its AI product following recent wealth management system onboarding. This suggests continued platform development for clients like Blacksilver and TITL.

announcements.headline: Exercise of Warrants, Issue of Equity and TVR
Virtual Card Soft Launch
announcements.insight: RCGH launches a virtual card, following Blacksilver and TITL onboarding to its wealth management system in September.

announcements.headline: TITL Onboarded to Wealth Management System
announcements.insight: RCGH continues its wealth management system onboarding, following Blacksilver in September. This suggests ongoing operational expansion.

announcements.headline: Blacksilver Onboarded to Wealth Management System
announcements.insight: RCGH secured a financial services award in August. This system onboard follows that recognition, indicating operational progress.

announcements.headline: Appointment of Executive Director and CFO
announcements.insight: RC365 Holding appoints an Executive Director and CFO. This board change follows recent AGM results and award recognitions.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: The AGM results confirm shareholder approval of matters raised in the July placing and credit facility. This finalizes the capital raise announced earlier in the year.

announcements.headline: Financial Services Award
announcements.insight: RCGH receives another industry recognition following its July award. This reinforces brand visibility but lacks financial specifics for shareholder valuation.

announcements.headline: Notification of Filing of Documents
announcements.insight: RCGH filed documents following its July credit facility. This administrative step confirms procedural compliance rather than indicating new strategic developments.

announcements.headline: RC365 Recognised at Hong Kong MVC Awards
announcements.insight: RCGH receives recognition at an awards ceremony. This follows its July credit facility and annual report publication.

announcements.headline: Final Results and Publication of Annual Report
announcements.insight: RCGH publishes final results following its July capital raise. Shareholders should monitor how the new funds support the RC3.0 launch and Blacksilver partnership.

announcements.headline: Placing & $2m Credit Facility
announcements.insight: The placing raises capital following the recent strategic partnership. This funding supports the ongoing development of the RC3.0 application launched in June.

announcements.headline: Strategic Partnership with Blacksilver Trust
announcements.insight: RC365 Holding announces a strategic partnership with Blacksilver Trust. This follows the soft launch of the RC3.0 application in June 2026.

announcements.headline: Soft Launch of RC3.0 Application
announcements.insight: RC365 Holding announces a soft launch of its RC3.0 application. This marks the first product-related development in the company's recorded history.
